protocol.outcome: Live repo-wide BM25 independent of agent-controlled rg JSON; relative score fusion preserves lexical score gaps while combining semantics.
protocol.fusion: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of min-max normalized BM25 and semantic cosine over the candidate union. Flat score distributions contribute zero, deterministic lexical tie order. No threshold or weight tuning on RepoQA.
protocol.candidates: Top 200 nonzero corpus BM25 chunks plus all explicitly supplied rg context groups. Corpus term statistics exclude supplemental rg groups. No NL-to-rg word gate. No embedding source index.
protocol.boundaries: Preserve CLI positional syntax, output source fields, model selection, ignore defaults, no writes to searched corpus, exit codes, offline behavior. Add optional --rg-json FILE (- for stdin) and --explain with --json. Full token content embedded; duplicate/contained output suppressed, unique overlapping source preserved.
failure_modes: Strong BM25 score gaps erased by rank-only fusion
Flat score normalization divides by zero
No lexical matches still returns arbitrary zero-score chunks
Binary or ignored files leak through default file enumeration
RG input cannot add candidates lacking question tokens
RG input is stale, malformed, outside requested scope or contains unsafe filenames
Duplicate and partial-overlap source discarded incorrectly
Padding or truncation changes content embeddings
Query scores change with result count
Search writes to repo or reuses stale source
Hidden benchmark failures or different token budgets
protocol.verification: Write CLI acceptance before implementation; run real downloaded models offline, existing E2E and chunker checks, fmt and clippy. Run identical pinned 600 RepoQA queries on baseline and candidate, forced code model, top50, exact source and token-budget scoring, separate 3x sequential latency panel. Report saved 60-query subset separately. Preserve per-query regressions.
protocol.limits: Local RepoQA retrieval adaptation, not official model task score. Familiar dataset; public training overlap unaudited. No agent-generated regex claims in NL-only benchmark. M5 Max, warm OS caches, cached model/parsers. No UI changes; visual screenshots not applicable.

ranking_note: All six complete-function losses remain in the candidate output, but move later beyond the source-token budget. This compares the complete pipeline change; it does not isolate score fusion from candidate discovery, complete embeddings or overlap handling.
